expires_at.description: When the offer expires (its Expiration), RFC 3339 with milliseconds; null when it has no expiry

gets.description: Funded base quantity of the offer, a decimal string in units of `base` (XRP in XRP, not drops), on both sides

owner.description: The account that placed the offer (its maker, the offer's Account)

pays.description: Funded quote quantity of the offer, a decimal string in units of `quote` (XRP in XRP, not drops), on both sides

age_seconds.description: Age of our read at response time, not of the ledger close time

as_of.description: When we read the data from the ledger (our read time), not the ledger close time

cache.description: Cache state; a composite answer reports the worst state of its reads, miss above stale

ledger_index.description: Ledger the data comes from; ledger_state says whether it is validated or open

ledger_state.description: State of the ledger ledger_index names: open for the fee read, which reads the open ledger, else validated; a composite answer is open only when every read is

stale.description: True when served past its fresh TTL (stale-on-error)

asks.description: One level per funded offer, in book order, best (lowest) price first, not a price aggregate; offers expired at or before the close time of the latest validated ledger are left out, possibly a few seconds early

asks_truncated.description: True when the ask side's `book_offers` page returned as many offers as the depth bucket, counted before zero-amount offers are skipped

base.description: Base asset queried, in the canonical form the route reads (echo)

base_currency_ascii.description: Readable text of `base`'s 40-hex currency code; null when not printable ASCII; absent for XRP and 3-character codes

best_ask.description: Lowest ask price, quote per base; null when there are no asks or the best ask is zero

best_bid.description: Highest bid price, quote per base; null when there are no bids or the best bid is zero

bids.description: One level per funded offer, in book order, best (highest) price first, from the base-asset side, not a price aggregate; offers expired at or before the close time of the latest validated ledger are left out, possibly a few seconds early

bids_truncated.description: True when the bid side's `book_offers` page returned as many offers as the depth bucket, counted before zero-amount offers are skipped

crossed.description: True when best_bid is above best_ask; null when a side is empty or its best price is zero

depth.description: The requested depth, echoed; 10, the default, when the request names none

ask_depth.description: Funded ask quantity within the band, a decimal string in units of `base`

bid_depth.description: Funded bid quantity within the band, a decimal string in units of `base`

half_width_bps.description: Band half-width around mid, in basis points: 10, 50 or 100

depth_bands.description: Funded base quantity per side within 10, 50 and 100 bps of mid, bounds included; null when a side is empty or its best price is zero

depth_effective.description: Depth bucket served: the requested depth rounded up to 10, 50 or 100, at most 100. Each side lists at most this many levels

domain.description: PermissionedDomain id queried, upper-case hex (echo of `domain`); null when the request sent none (the open book)

funded_total.description: Per side: total funded base quantity of the levels read

ask_depth.description: Funded ask quantity of the levels read, a decimal string in units of `base`

bid_depth.description: Funded bid quantity of the levels read, a decimal string in units of `base`

mid.description: Midpoint of best_bid and best_ask, quote per base; null when a side is empty or its best price is zero

quote.description: Quote asset queried, in the canonical form the route reads (echo)

quote_currency_ascii.description: Readable text of `quote`'s 40-hex currency code; null when not printable ASCII; absent for XRP and 3-character codes

spread_bps.description: spread_price / mid x 10,000, in basis points, rounded half-up to 2 decimals; null when a side is empty or its best price is zero

spread_price.description: best_ask minus best_bid, quote per base (negative when crossed); null when a side is empty or its best price is zero

description: CLOB order book for a currency pair with unfunded offers removed. When to use: To read executable liquidity for a pair on the XRPL central limit order book (CLOB). Prefer another tool: Not for AMM liquidity (use the amm page) and not for a cost estimate (use the slippage page). Example: xrpl_orderbook {"base":"XRP","quote":"USD.rvYAfWj5gh67oV6fW32ZzP3Aw4Eubs59B"} Paid: 0.01452 USDC or 0.0121 EURC per call on Solana mainnet, VAT included. With prepaid credits, debit per call: 0.0025 EUR-denominated units (approx 400 calls per bundle) or 0.003 USD-denominated units (approx 273 calls per bundle).

base.description: Base currency: `XRP`, or `CODE.issuer`: `CODE` is a 3-character standard code or 40 hexadecimal digits, and `issuer` is a classic XRPL address. Standard codes are case-sensitive: `usd` and `USD` are different tokens, so send the exact code. A standard code uses letters, digits or `?!@#$%^&*<>(){}[]|` and is never `XRP`; percent-encode the symbols in a URL (for example `%3F` for `?`). A 40-hex code is read in any case, and the 40-hex form of a standard code means that code.

depth.description: Levels per side: a positive integer no larger than 9007199254740991, rounded up to 10, 50 or 100; a larger depth is served at 100 (see depth_effective)

domain.description: Optional PermissionedDomain id (64 hex): reads that domain's permissioned order book; slippage then skips the AMM

quote.description: Quote currency: `XRP`, or `CODE.issuer`: `CODE` is a 3-character standard code or 40 hexadecimal digits, and `issuer` is a classic XRPL address. Standard codes are case-sensitive: `usd` and `USD` are different tokens, so send the exact code. A standard code uses letters, digits or `?!@#$%^&*<>(){}[]|` and is never `XRP`; percent-encode the symbols in a URL (for example `%3F` for `?`). A 40-hex code is read in any case, and the 40-hex form of a standard code means that code.
